Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 23
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly treated a Bing search snippet (“Adults and Children - $8.25”) as a verified, current daily ticket price and added it to the “GIVEN OR VERIFIED FACTS” without confirming on the official site. It later also accepted membership pricing from a SERP snippet without verification. These unverified/outdated inputs led the Assistant to compute with wrong numbers, producing an incorrect savings result instead of the correct $45.
